extension.description: Beetle PC Engine je fork Mednafenovog PC Engine drajvera.[CR][CR]Ovaj PC Engine modul je precizniji od Beetle PC Engine Fast modula, ali na štetu brzine.
Beetle PC Engine je odvozen od jádra PC Engine z Mednafenu.[CR][CR]Tento modul PC Engine je přesnější než modul Beetle PC Engine Fast, a to za cenu nižší rychlosti.
Beetle PC Engine er en fork af Mednafens PC Engine-driver.[CR][CR]Dette PC Engine-modul er mere præcist end Beetle PC Engine Fast-modulet på bekostning af hastighed.
Beetle PC Engine ist ein Ableger des PC-Engine-Treibers von Mednafen[CR][CR]Dieses PC-Engine-Modul ist genauer als das Beetle PC-Engine-Fast-Modul, allerdings auf Kosten der Geschwindigkeit.
Beetle PC Engine is a fork of Mednafen's PC Engine driver.[CR][CR]This PC Engine module is more accurate than the Beetle PC Engine Fast module, at the expense of speed.
Beetle PC Engine es una bifurcación del controlador PC Engine de Mednafen[CR][CR]Este módulo PC Engine es más preciso que el módulo Beetle PC Engine Fast, a expensas de la velocidad.
Is forc de thiománaí PC Engine Mednafen é Beetle PC Engine.[CR][CR]Tá an modúl PC Engine seo níos cruinne ná an modúl Beetle PC Engine Fast, ar chostas luas.
Beetle PC Engine è un fork del driver PC Engine di Mednafen.[CR][CR]Questo modulo PC Engine è più preciso del modulo Beetle PC Engine Fast, a scapito della velocità.
Beetle PC Engine — это форк драйвера PC Engine от Mednafen.[CR][CR]Этот модуль PC Engine более точен, чем модуль Beetle PC Engine Fast, но за счёт скорости.
Beetle PC Engine är en avknoppning av Mednafens PC Engine-drivrutin[CR][CR]Denna PC Engine-modul är mer exakt än Beetle PC Engine Fast-modulen, på bekostnad av hastigheten.
Beetle PC 引擎是 Mednafen 的 PC 引擎驱动程序的一个分支。[CR][CR]此 PC 引擎模块以速度为代价，取得比 Beetle PC 引擎快速模块更精确的效果。
